title: Remove the shared default administrator password
description: Replace the hard-coded initial administrator password with a one-time bootstrap secret supplied through a protected environment variable, without silently changing existing administrator accounts.
acceptance_criteria: No usable administrator password is present in source, scripts, tests, documentation or browser assets.
A new installation requires an explicitly supplied one-time bootstrap secret and fails safely when it is missing.
Existing installations are not overwritten or reset during startup.
Unit tests cover missing, valid and already-initialized bootstrap cases.

human_gate.reason: This changes administrator bootstrap behavior and a protected SeedData path; approve the rollout and recovery plan before execution.
